classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one small (~50-residue) soluble de novo protein candidate using ESM3 joint sequence+structure co-generation, perform sequence-level and structure-level QC, and produce a ranked candidate summary.
assumptions: A 50-residue seed sequence is used as the ESM3 generation prompt; ESM3 stochastically diverges from the seed to produce a novel design at temperature 0.7.
ESM3 small open model (esm3_sm_open_v1) runs locally on available hardware; no cloud inference is invoked.
ESM3 emits a pLDDT-annotated structure file accessible as outputs.gen_esm3.structure_path and the generated sequence as outputs.gen_esm3.sequence.
Solubility is assessed via sequence_analysis liabilities (hydrophobic patch length, net charge) at physiological pH 7.4.
structure_analysis checks per-residue exposure and contacts on the ESM3-generated backbone using DSSP secondary-structure assignment.
A single candidate is sufficient for this compact workflow; rank_designs top_k=1 returns the best (only) result.
No target fold topology, functional motif, or active-site residue constraints are imposed; the design is fully unconstrained de novo.
submit_candidate is excluded from this plan per workflow contract; submission is a post-ranking decision made after actual outputs are available.

success_criteria.candidate_generated: ESM3 returns a diverged sequence and a structure_path for the 50-residue seed input
success_criteria.sequence_qc_passed: sequence_analysis reports no critical liabilities: no hydrophobic stretch longer than 8 residues, net charge within [-5, +5] at pH 7.4
success_criteria.structure_qc_passed: structure_analysis reports mean pLDDT above 70 and no buried ionisable residues flagged as liabilities
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns a top-1 candidate record aggregating prediction outputs, sequence-QC results, and structure-QC results
